notes.title: Undefined Survivors - Dev Letter
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Undefined Survivors.
We truly appreciate your continued interest and the valuable feedback from all our players.

The development team is keenly aware of current challenges, such as the lack of content, and we are sincerely addressing these issues. In order to meet your expectations, we have been holding many discussions within the team.
Today, we would like to share with you the direction we envision for the future of Undefined Survivors.

[h2][b]◆ Our Vision for the Future of Undefined Survivors[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*][h3][b]Enemies Emerging at Night[/b][/h3]
To deliver tense, survival-driven gameplay, we plan to introduce enemies that attack during the night, creating an atmosphere where the night is a time to endure and defend.
[/list]
[list]
[*][h3][b]Enhanced Base Defense and Equipment Expansion[/b][/h3]
We aim to deepen strategic gameplay by adding traps and defensive structures, along with durability for buildings, enabling repairs and base management.
[/list]
[list]
[*][h3][b]Periodic Raid Events[/b][/h3]
We are planning large-scale raid events that occur at specific intervals, accompanied by dramatic environmental changes such as rising water levels and altered skies to heighten immersion.
[/list]
[list]
[*][h3][b]Support for First-Person Perspective (FPS)[/b][/h3]
To enhance realism, we are working to implement a first-person viewpoint that allows players to see their hands and equipment.
[/list]
[list]
[*][h3][b]Underwater Movement Improvements[/b][/h3]
In addition to current underwater controls, we are considering a new choice that allows walking-style movement similar to on land.
[/list]
[list]
[*][h3][b]Mission and Trade System[/b][/h3]
By encountering other characters in the world, players will be able to take on reward-based missions and engage in item exchanges.
[/list]
[list]
[*][h3][b]Expanded Exploration Areas[/b][/h3]
We aim to make indoor environments more immersive, adding new elements of discovery and a greater sense of achievement during exploration.
[/list]
[list]
[*][h3][b]Full UI/UX Overhaul[/b][/h3]
The user interface and overall usability of the game will be redesigned for better clarity, responsiveness, and visual consistency.
[/list]
[list]
[*][h3][b]Daily Quality-of-Life Improvements and Issue Fixes[/b][/h3]
We will continue to address known issues and improve the overall gameplay experience day by day.
[/list]

[h2][b]◆ In Closing[/b][/h2]
The information presented here is the current concept and direction of the project.
We will continue to review and adapt our development roadmap based on progress and player feedback.

At its core, Undefined Survivors strives to build a meaningful world—one that explores the questions, “Why survive?” and “Why build?” The development team remains fully committed to this goal.

Once again, I would like to thank all of you who are building this world with us.
We look forward to hearing more of your thoughts and impressions.

Thank you for your continued support of Undefined Survivors.

notes.title: v1.0.1 Update Notice
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Undefined Survivors.
We have updated the game with the following improvements.
 
・Fixed a bug where the bag dropped upon character death would sometimes not appear on the map as an icon.
・Changed behavior so that once all items are retrieved from a dropped bag, the bag disappears from the field.
・Fixed a bug where sleeping bags and beds set as respawn points would sometimes not appear in the respawn location list.
・Modified inventory and settings screens so they can now be closed using the Esc key.
・Changed player icon colors on the map to match the color linked to the selected character.
・Fixed a bug where the decay value of consumable items would not decrease as intended.
・Fixed a bug where, for equipment items stacked in one slot, the entire stack would require repairs once the durability of the first item hit zero, regardless of how many remained.
・Fixed a bug that allowed players to equip items from the hotbar even if they required repairs.
・Changed behavior so that placeholder buildings can now be removed without needing to equip a hammer.
・The inventory screen can now be opened and closed using the Tab key.
・Various minor bug fixes have also been implemented.
 
Thank you for your continued support of Undefined Survivors.
